reviews.text: Staff and physicians are so welcoming you just want to go back to visit them. I recommend this place.
Dr Gaines is always great. We are out of town,  and he called me to explain things like my daughter-in-law could not.
Great pricing, very informative, quick wait time!

I love CityVet!! They always display genuine concern for our pets. Our 2 cats are established patients and we recently took our dog to establish care and address a health concern. They were caring and gentle with her even though she doesn’t do well at vet visits. I love how they inform you of the estimated cost before treatment. I would highly recommend CityVet for your fur baby’s health and wellness.
Great service and pricing
Friendly staff with my overly anxious Australian Shepherd. 🦴❤️We were in and out quickly.
They were very kind to my timid puppy. Very knowledgeable and put my mind at ease. Highly recommend.

We are very pleased with the veterinary services provided by Dr. Gaines and his staff.  The office appointments are always timely, the examinations are thorough, the willingness to discuss concerns of a pet’s issues, and the cleanliness of the facility is top notch.

The staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Dr Gaines and his team  are focused on customer service and pet wellbeing.   From welcome at reception, to Vet techs exams to meeting Dr Gaines - the office always makes me and my pets feel like we matter. i recommend Dr Gaines and his team all day long!
The staff and doc have always been great!  We’ve always had good access and fantastic care for our dog.  Highly recommend!

The vets here are so caring and very easy to talk to!  We love that they always give multiple options/opinions of care and not always the most expensive.  All of the Docs and technicians are amazing and make us and our pups feel at ease and comfortable.  Additionally, the front desk ladies are always so nice and professional! Thank you for the great care:)

I have a pitbull mix male dog and had always been nervous about taking him to a vet. I was driving home from work and saw a doberman leaving the vet so it made me feel a little more comfortable seeing “big scary “ dog there. The staff and vet made me feel very welcome and they took time with my dog. He had ear infections and they packed his ears. He is doing much better and with his ears doing better it’s allowing him to be a big baby again.

Very happy with this place.
Have been going to Dr. Gains for more than 10 years. Experience has always been great. My animals have been treated great.

Dr. Gaines is the best... He really cares.
.

Doc and staff are exactly what we hoped for the first time we walked in. We have now visited a few times for various reasons and our now comfortable referring friends and family.
Thank you

I highly recommend this veterinary office. The staff is always professional, friendly, and the clinic is consistently clean and welcoming. One thing I really appreciate is how thorough the veterinarian is during every visit. He takes the time to carefully examine my dog and make sure all of her needs are addressed.

What sets this office apart is their honesty and transparency. They clearly explain the essential treatment my dog truly needs, while also offering additional options that could help keep her more comfortable. I never feel pressured into unnecessary services or medications.

I also greatly appreciate that they provide a clear range of expected costs upfront, which helps avoid surprises and allows me to make informed decisions. They work with me to focus on what is most important for my dog’s health while still keeping care affordable.

Another huge plus is their availability. Whenever I call, they are usually able to see my dog within 24 hours, which has been incredibly helpful with my schedule and during stressful situations.

Overall, this office provides compassionate, practical, and affordable care. The veterinarian is genuinely kind, and I always leave feeling confident that my dog received excellent treatment.
Dr. Gaines is amazing and has helped me with the passing of my old ladies Beans and Baylee and continues to care for our bully Brisket. I’ve never had bad customer service and I always feel welcomed.
Best staff and vet I’ve ever been to.
Dr Naranjo and the staff were outstanding , very patient with my nervous 80 lb dog.
Very attentive and good advice for first visit there.
Great service and personnel. Very informative
Excellent service!
This place and the staff are amazing and I love taking my pups there. The boys get spoiled and it’s a welcome atmosphere with great service.
Everyone was very friendly was amazing!
Friendly workers, clean and safe environment.Happy to be here to bring my sisters dogs and mine.
Dr. Gaines and his staff are by far the BEST!! Thanks for taking such good care of Sadie.
Dr. Gaines and his team are the best.  I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else.  They are all so nice and Dr. Gaines always explains things well and gives you options on caring for your pet.
I & Charli felt the kindness of everyone as I walked in for the first time being there. Everyone very kind

This was my first visit to this vet clinic and I highly recommend! I'll be bringing my other cats here. Dr. Gaines and his staff are phenomenal. From the ladies at the front desk to the medical staff, everyone is super friendly and welcoming. And the prices were competitive considering most vet clinics charge similar rates (in my experience at least). I also appreciate that Dr. Gaines looked to address all problems with my cat to see what is the root of the problem. His depth of knowledge makes me feel confident in his medical judgment and care of my cat.
Excellent staff & can't beat Dr Gaines. Hardly ever have to wait to be seen on time. Another excellent experience at the Vet. Staff & Dr are fantastic.
Picked up cat meds.  Good service.   Positive experience.
I like that all are courteous and comforting.  Also the quickness.
Dr. Gaines and his team are the BEST!  Their office is clean and they are efficient getting you in whenever you have a need.  Thank you for all you do for our fur babies!!
Always easy to get in for an appointment and the dr.s are thorough. Very Thankful for this office

I would recommend this Vet. Office staff is always friendly and empathetic and very helpful. I recently had to say goodbye to my old girl. I called ahead and explained that we will need help getting her into the office. When we arrived, the staff was ready for us. They carried her on a gurney directly into a room which was nicely prepared with a nice, soft Dogbed on the floor, and they were so gentle with her. City Vet Kallison ranch made the worst possible reason to visit a vet more bearable. They also always take good care of our other furry Family member,  even though he is extremely anxious and hyper.
Friendly, professional staff.
Im happy with Kallison Ranch. They take care of my 2 🐕 🐶 even the bigger dog who's very scared

They were thorough examining her and took time to offer me options for treatment financially.  I won’t be taking my pets anywhere else but to this vet moving forward, this team is simply the BEST.

Staff is amazing.  Best groomer we have ever had.  They are so good to my baby.
Highly recommend

City Vet placed my dog on six medications and hopefully it will help him heal. I am so beyond livid with PetSmart that I talked to their manager and they’re seeing why it wasn’t done in the first place.

I’m hoping City Vet stands to the acclaim that I’ve heard from other people.

Update: brought in a neglected dog and the nurses and doctors there are ANGEL'S!!! Yes, it was extremely pricey, but, you know, for a fur baby. I wouldn't eat for a couple of weeks to keep them healthy.
Love you guys!
Fast and very friendly
The staff is very friendly
City Vet at Kallison Ranch has been a favorite Vet office of ours Dr Gaines and staff are just amazing with all my furbabies!

Today I took my dogs for their annual vaccinations. They received them without any problems. However, they didn't provide them with their complete vaccination plan. From the moment you arrive, they try to sell you other things you didn't ask for. It's very sad and very poor professional ethics to place more emphasis on selling medical procedures than on actually caring for and being more attentive to the animals. Dr. Naranjo only saw you for two minutes during the entire process while you were at the clinic. I didn't trust her for any reason. They took the dogs to the back of the clinic to take their temperature and do blood tests, but you never actually see them do them. The costs are out of range, too high, to choose this clinic as your trusted place for your pets. It's not worth it if there aren't doctors who are friendly with animals or people, and they place more importance on their administrative processes and are more concerned with giving you quotes for services. The truth is, they're losing their essence as pet doctors.
The assistant & doctor were very nice & understanding & helpful
Dr Gaines and his staff are amazing.
Fantastic clinic!  They treated myself and Rex very well and made us both feel right at home!  Fantastic neighborhood vet! Great work everyone!

2nd time and last time using this vet today. Took our dog carmela in to get refill on her apoquel back on 7/22 of this year at the time dr suggested we get a skin test done. At the time couldn't afford the additional $65 charge so we had to pass and just get her meds refilled. Took Mela in today to get a grooming and asked about getting the test done today and to my surprise they wanted to charge another $65 fee for dr visit just to tell me she needs the same test. I thought this place had the best interest of my pet in mind but apparently they value profits.

City Vet | Kallison Ranch  is the best everybody? There is so friendly and professional. Even when taking care of my obnoxiously excitable Belgian Malinois  Mazzy Star.  For a place that has animals in and out all day, that place is spotless. They make everything as convenient as possible.

Dr Gaines is so knowledgeable and compassionate when caring for our beagle puppy.  He quickly diagnosed Beau’s condition and sent us on our way with medication in short order. Regina at the front desk was very helpful in scheduling the appointment and we also appreciate the timely estimates for services planned today. Many thanks to the whole team!
Dr. Gaines and his staff take their time to make sure all my questions are answered.  They are attentive to my dog and I am thrilled with the care we get here!

Got an appt within a couple days for our cat, it wasn’t an emergency, and didn’t have to wait long before seeing the Dr. The Vet and Vet tech were both very nice and knowledgeable. Very happy with our experience at CityVet. Would absolutely recommend!

The front desk and vet tech were amazing and extremely friendly.
I wasn’t very happy with how Dr. Gaines was towards my dog. While I was alone in the room I had let go of my dogs leash. The Doctor walked in without knocking so I wasn’t able to grab my dogs leash. My dog gets excited and jumped on him and right away raised his voice to my dogs telling him not to jump in him. My dog loves people so he gets excited. Throughout the exam he just seemed annoyed with how hyper my dog was. It was the 1st vet I’ve ever seen that seemed to be annoyed with my happy dog. If I were to go back it would be only because of the location and the girls being so nice, but I would definitely see a different doctor.

Their facility is always in pristine condition and I appreciate that they have finance options with Care credit in the event that you have those unexpected, more expensive visits. 10/10 recommend, I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else!

Stopped in and asked if they were available for some shots, and I got told everyone was on lunch and only do appointments. Got the impression I was bothering them.

CityVet has been absolutely amazing! Finding a vet who truly listens to our concerns, answers all of our questions, is patient and kind, and, most importantly, provides the best care for our sweet boys is so important to us. CityVet Kallison Ranch does all of that and more!

The front desk staff is always so welcoming and kind, greeting our pups with love every time we walk in—especially Regina! She knows our boys by name and always takes the time to say hi to them, which means the world to us.

The vet techs are incredibly sweet and detailed when explaining what the doctor will be examining. Our vet, Dr. Naranjo, has been absolutely wonderful. She is always thorough, attentive, and takes the time to answer all of our questions. It’s clear that she and the entire team genuinely care about our pets’ well-being.

Our pups are our world, and it brings us so much comfort knowing they are in the hands of a vet team that truly wants the best for them.

Lastly, the grooming services here are just as fantastic! Alyssa is the best groomer we’ve ever had, she adores our boys, and they absolutely love her in return!

Overall, CityVet Kallison Ranch has gone above and beyond for our pets, and we couldn’t be more grateful for their care. Highly recommend!

Did not appreciate being guilted by the nurse about spending $2k on having my dog’s teeth removed. I was fully aware of the seriousness of his condition, which is why I brought him in. However, the receptionist quoted me $450 over the phone, and the quote I received in office was well over $2k.

I had an emergency with my cat today. CityVet had a same-day appointment and took excellent care of him! I’m so grateful!!! And, the visit was much cheaper than anticipated. CityVet offers a military discount; and, staff adds it to your account so you don’t need to inquire about the discount each visit - it’s already done! Will def give this place my business again!!!
